papers.claim: No net-of-cost signal at 4h-24h on 50 Binance USDT-M perps is confirmed after 2106 trials across four waves: the two candidates that reached the referee both returned 'not confirmed', one because its own placebo kill fired on the 2026-05-01..2026-10-22 look and one because the look was never taken.
papers.decision: File the tournament as a negative on the question 'does a net-of-cost signal exist at 4h-24h on Binance perps': no confirmed survivor out of 2106 trials. Do not promote either candidate to a traded or forward-tested signal. Carry the flow24 one look forward as the single open item, with a corrected cost-monotone net metric and a dispersion-matched placebo, and treat f12, f20 and f21 as untested rather than dead.
papers.description: Plain-language result of the four-wave pre-registered discovery tournament for net-of-cost signals at 4h-24h horizons on 50 Binance USDT-M perpetuals. TOTAL TRIALS: 2106 across all waves (wave_digest trials_total), spread over 161 filed records. RULES (fixed, not changed): 14-19 bps round-trip cost plus funding actually crossed, walk-forward by year, 200-shuffled-day placebo maximum, effect-size floors 0.12 (train h1/h4) and 0.35 (held-out, h24), one look per candidate on the confirmation slice from 2026-05-01, nothing from 2026-10-23, 3 lockbox windows dropped, Binance-derived data only. SURVIVORS: exactly two candidates reached the referee stage and BOTH returned 'not confirmed'. (1) w204-f24-cand-mom7-h24-k5, cross-sectional 7-day momentum k=5 with a 24h hold: gross 145.5 bps/trade, net 126.5 bps/trade at 19 bps RT, n=1550 daily observations, placebo max 70.6, MDE floor 35 bps cleared. Referee r301 re-derived it bit-for-bit and it survived look-ahead (a 1-day signal lead would earn 323.2 net19 vs the real 126.5), cost +5 bps (121.5), funding (126.8), purge/embargo (133.3), ex-BTC/ETH/SOL (145.4) and a full parameter neighbourhood (93.9 to 179.2). It was still NOT CONFIRMED: on the one look at 2026-05-01..2026-10-22 it earned 221.8 bps/trade net but the look placebo max was 536.1 (real percentile 0.25), so its own placebo kill fired; top3_name_share was 0.505 and the ex-top3 universe earned 53.0 net19 against its own placebo max of 86.4. (2) w108-f08-cand-flow24-lowvol-h4, 24h taker-flow imbalance traded only in low-volatility regimes with a 4h hold: net 14.15 bps/trade at 19 bps RT, n=175194, placebo max 13.62, per-year 9.21/12.42/16.75/15.95/8.76. Referee r302 re-derived it exactly and it survived every discovery-side attack (look-ahead 14.30/13.85, future scramble 14.03, full-history-only 12.60, ex-majors 15.09, ex-top3 13.67, purge 14.12, smooth volrank and horizon neighbourhoods, top3-day 0.036, top3-name 0.145) and beat a fresh 200-shuffle placebo max of -5.13 with z=27.44. It was still NOT CONFIRMED because the ONE LOOK WAS NEVER TAKEN (look_taken false, look_n_trades 0) and because its cost-sensitivity is inverted (cost14 11.13, cost19 14.15, cost24 17.16, cost38 25.6), which means the headline number is a gross drift number rather than a net edge. DEAD FAMILIES (each filed as a negative with a trial ledger): f01 time-series momentum (gross edge <=4 bps, placebo max 3.858 vs best gross 2.265), f02 raw and cross-sectional short-horizon reversal (net -14.02 bps/trade), f03 cross-sectional momentum pre-referee (vol-scaled 7d k=5 h24 +21.0 bps but +5.0 on the pre-2021 cohort), f04 cross-sectional reversal (IC -0.029, t=-10.2, gross 6.63 vs 14 bps cost), f05 signed taker flow (gross 3.09, net -14.04), f06 large-trade flow (all 40 cells -18.29 to -20.73), f07 flow-price divergence/absorption (|IC| <= 0.014), f09 volatility breakout and compression (best +6.66 bps, t=1.08, top3_day_share 1.542), f10 funding level cross-section (net -7.02, t=-0.75), f11 funding change and extremes (best -5.46), f13 top-trader and account ratios (|IC| <= 0.044), f14 book depth imbalance (net -12.95), f15 BTC/ETH lead-lag (gross -3.03, net -17.83), f16 dispersion and rotation (net -0.33), f17 time-of-day and week seasonality (gross 10.86 < 14 bps floor), f18 volume and trade-count shocks (best gross 8.65, decays to -3.7 by 2026), f19 trade-size distribution (best gross 9.49, net -10.86), f22 listing age (net -11.3), f23 multi-feature model (best |rank-IC| 0.0409), plus the f24 wildcard sweeps (30 trials, best net -16.05; Donchian N=42 -12.38 to -35.23; funding-carry reversal -14.94/-16.34; pre-settlement window -14.36; age rotation and correlation-cluster rotation wrong-signed). UNTESTED, NOT REFUTED: f12 (OI change vs price), f20 (liquidation-cascade proxies), f21 (relative value/pairs, 12 trials void from a harness bug) and several f24 sub-questions were blocked by the sandbox memory ceiling or a harness fault and carry 0 evaluated trials; they must not be counted as negatives. VERDICT: no net-of-cost signal at 4h-24h on Binance perps is CONFIRMED. Zero of 2106 trials produced a confirmed survivor. The binding constraint is arithmetic: the best gross edges found anywhere in the tournament sit at or below the 14 bps cheap-tier round trip, and the two effects large enough to clear cost both failed on the confirmation side, one on its own placebo and one because the look was never taken. NEXT PRE-REGISTRATION: (a) take the flow24 one look with a corrected, cost-monotone net metric and a dispersion-matched placebo, since the current headline rises with cost and therefore cannot be a net edge; (b) require the ex-top3-symbol and full-history-only universes to pass their own placebo before any look is spent, because both candidates were symbol-concentrated; (c) replace the day-shuffle placebo with a dispersion-matched or joint cross-symbol permutation for cross-sectional signals, since the day shuffle is invariant or structurally negative for within-day cross-sections; (d) cap trials per family and reserve the final calls for the look, since the flow24 look was lost to budget exhaustion; (e) re-run f12, f20 and f21 with a streaming per-symbol loader before treating them as dead.

Referee r301: rederive_matches_claim true, attack_lead_minus1d_lookahead_net19_bps 323.2 vs real 126.5, attack_purge_embargo_year_boundary_net19_bps 133.3, attack_ex_btc_eth_sol_net19_bps 145.4, look_net_bps 221.8 vs look_placebo_max 536.1, look_real_percentile_in_placebo 0.25, top3_name_share 0.505, attack_ex_top3_syms_net19_bps 53.0 vs placebo max 86.4, verdict 'not confirmed'. Dead-family headline numbers as listed in the description, each quoted from its own digest record.
papers.kill_criterion: Close the 4h-24h net-of-cost search on this universe and cost model if the corrected flow24 look on 2026-05-01..2026-10-22 does not beat a dispersion-matched 200-shuffle placebo maximum at 19 bps RT plus funding, or if its net is not monotone decreasing in cost. Any future family is killed if its best gross edge on the walk-forward test years is below 14 bps per trade, since that is the cheapest round trip and no cost refinement can rescue it.
papers.limitations: The verdict is a statement about this universe, this cost model and these horizons, not about market efficiency in general. Three families (f12 OI change vs price, f20 liquidation-cascade proxies, f21 relative value/pairs) carry zero evaluated trials because of sandbox memory ceilings and a pandas alignment bug, so they are untested rather than dead. The flow24 candidate is neither confirmed nor refuted: its one look was never taken, so the tournament ends with an open question rather than a closed one. The mom7 candidate failed its own placebo on the confirmation slice, but that slice is 117 days with a cross-sectional forward-return dispersion of 3337 bps versus 2048 bps in discovery, so the day-shuffle placebo may simply lack power there; a dispersion-matched placebo was not run. Funding coverage is 39 of 50 symbols and only 21 of those have pre-2026 history, so every funding-costed number is large-cap biased. All numbers here are quoted from the wave digest and the two referee reports; nothing was recomputed.
papers.title: Wave 4 final report: 2106 trials, zero confirmed net-of-cost signals at 4h-24h on 50 Binance USDT-M perps

papers.claim: Wave 4 closes the 4h-24h net-of-cost search as unconfirmed after 2106 trials with zero confirmed survivors, and the next pre-registration spends exactly one look on flow24 with a corrected cost-monotone metric and a dispersion-matched placebo, gated on ex-top3 and full-history universes passing first.
papers.decision: Close wave 4 as unconfirmed. Spend the next wave on exactly one look at flow24 with a corrected cost-monotone net metric and a dispersion-matched placebo, gated on the ex-top3 and full-history universes passing their own placebo first. Do not re-open any of the 22 dead families without a new mechanism. Re-run f12, f20 and f21 with a streaming per-symbol loader before treating them as dead. If the corrected flow24 look fails, close the 4h-24h net-of-cost search on this universe and cost model permanently.
papers.description: The ten-line decision that closes wave 4 and sets the next pre-registration. Line 1: the tournament is closed as UNCONFIRMED, not as a discovery — 2106 trials across 161 records produced zero confirmed net-of-cost signals at 4h-24h on 50 Binance USDT-M perps. Line 2: two candidates reached the referee and both returned 'not confirmed'; w204-f24-cand-mom7-h24-k5 (net 126.5 bps/trade at 19 bps RT, placebo max 70.6) failed its own placebo on the 2026-05-01..2026-10-22 look (221.8 net versus a look placebo max of 536.1, real percentile 0.25), and w108-f08-cand-flow24-lowvol-h4 (net 14.15, placebo max 13.62) never took its look at all (look_taken false, look_n_trades 0). Line 3: the binding constraint is arithmetic, not search effort — the best gross edges found anywhere sit at or below the 14 bps cheap-tier round trip (f01 4.22, f05 3.09, f18 8.65, f19 9.49, f17 10.86, f04 6.63), so no cost-model refinement can rescue them. Line 4: 22 families are dead with ledgers (f01, f02, f03, f04, f05, f06, f07, f09, f10, f11, f13, f14, f15, f16, f17, f18, f19, f22, f23 and the f24 wildcard sweeps), and none of them should be re-opened without a new mechanism. Line 5: three families are UNTESTED, not refuted — f12 (OI change vs price), f20 (liquidation-cascade proxies) and f21 (relative value/pairs, 12 trials void from a harness bug) — and they carry zero evaluated trials because of sandbox memory ceilings, so they must be excluded from any multiple-testing correction and re-run with a streaming per-symbol loader. Line 6: the next pre-registration takes exactly one look, on flow24, with a corrected cost-monotone net metric (the current headline rises with cost: 11.13 at 14 bps, 14.15 at 19, 17.16 at 24, 25.6 at 38, which means it is a gross drift number and not a net edge) and a dispersion-matched placebo. Line 7: every future candidate must pass the ex-top3-symbol and full-history-only universes against their own placebo BEFORE the look is spent, because both wave-4 candidates were symbol-concentrated (mom7 top3_name_share 0.505 with ex-top3 53.0 against a placebo max of 86.4). Line 8: the placebo rule changes — the within-symbol day shuffle is invariant or structurally negative for within-day cross-sections, so cross-sectional signals get a joint cross-symbol or dispersion-matched permutation, and placebo mean, std, p95 and max are all reported. Line 9: budget rules change — cap trials per family, run the placebo on the FIRST promising variant rather than the last, and reserve the final calls for the look, because the flow24 look was lost to budget exhaustion after 40 of 40 trials were spent. Line 10: if the corrected flow24 look fails, the 4h-24h net-of-cost search on this universe and cost model is closed permanently and the next wave moves to a different horizon or a maker-fill cost model, not to more variants of the same families.

papers.kill_criterion: Kill the flow24 revival if, on 2026-05-01..2026-10-22, its net at 19 bps RT plus funding is not monotone decreasing in cost, or does not exceed a dispersion-matched 200-shuffle placebo maximum, or if the ex-top3-symbol or full-history-only universe is negative. Kill the whole 4h-24h net-of-cost search on this universe and cost model if that look fails, and move the next wave to a different horizon or a maker-fill cost model rather than to more variants of the same families.
papers.limitations: This plan spends the next wave's budget on a single look at one candidate, so if flow24 fails there is no second candidate in reserve; that is deliberate, because the alternative is more variants of families whose gross edges are already below the cost floor. The dispersion-matched placebo has not been implemented or validated on this dataset, so its power on a 117-day confirmation slice is unknown. The three untested families (f12, f20, f21) may still contain a signal, and this plan does not fund them. All numbers are quoted from the wave digest and the two referee reports; no new computation was performed.
papers.title: Wave 4 decision: close the 4h-24h net-of-cost search as unconfirmed, carry one open look, and re-pre-register on gross-first gates

papers.decision: Adopt (1) the host-built read-only panel, (2) the resource preflight in SELF_CHECK, and (3) the streaming per-symbol evaluation shape as the default, in the next wave's protocol and worker prompt. Do not change any evaluation rule: this is plumbing only.
papers.description: EVIDENCE FROM THIS RUN. Wave 1 used 1992 run_code calls for 25 filed records (calls_per_filed 83.9) at spent_per_filed_usd 0.21; wave 2 used 2254 run_code calls for 24 filed plus 1 partial at spent_per_filed_usd 0.219. The digest shows where those calls went: w120 reports run_code_calls_wasted_on_oom 40 of 59 with trials_used 0; w208 reports run_code_calls_wasted 85 with trials_used 0; w214 reports run_code_calls_wasted_on_oom 52 of 70 with trials_used 0; w215 reports wasted_calls 55 with signal_trials_run 0; w221 reports identical_script_failures 20 with trials_used 0; w207 reports n_failed_pipeline_runs 30 with trials_used 0; w213 and w112 report the same class of failure. Several of these records independently diagnose the same two causes: a pooled 50-symbol 5m panel does not fit the sandbox (w112, w120, w201, w214, w217, w221) and /work has a hard per-file cap (w208: file_cap_bytes 268435456). By contrast wave 3, which ran only 95 run_code calls for 3 filed records, reached time_to_median_finding_min 2.5 versus 16.7 in wave 1 and 20.8 in wave 2. CHANGE. (1) The host builds and mounts a read-only panel once per wave (4h/8h/12h/24h wide frames on the closed-bar convention, a per-bar funding matrix with NaN where a symbol has no coverage, and a symbol age table), so no worker rebuilds it. (2) The protocol's SELF_CHECK block prints total RAM, the virtual-memory cap, the per-file size cap and the free space on /work, and asserts that the planned pooled matrix fits before trial 1. (3) The protocol states the streaming per-symbol evaluation shape (load one symbol, emit per-trade rows, pool only those rows) as the default for 50-symbol studies. EXPECTED EFFECT. The digest's own estimates put the recoverable budget at 40-85 calls per affected worker; at wave-1 scale that is the majority of the 1992 calls, and it converts trials_used 0 filings into real evaluations. HOW TO TEST. In the next wave, record per-agent (a) run_code calls spent before the first evaluated trial, (b) trials_used at filing, (c) count of OOM/EFBIG/identical-output failures. Success = median calls-before-first-trial falls and the number of trials_used 0 filings falls, with calls_per_filed below the wave-1 83.9 and wave-2 97.4 baselines.

papers.title: Swarm improvement: wave 1-2 spent most of their run_code budget on data plumbing and sandbox limits, not on hypotheses; ship a prebuilt panel plus a memory/disk preflight

papers.decision: Adopt the identical-output refusal, the distinct-result budget counter, and the explicit worker rule in the next wave. This changes tooling and prompting only; it does not change trial counting, costs, placebo rules or effect-size floors.
papers.description: EVIDENCE FROM THIS RUN. The digest contains repeated, independently reported instances of the same failure mode: a worker re-sends a script that has already failed and the harness charges it again. w215 reports wasted_calls 55 caused by re-running one broken Corwin-Schultz estimator at quantiles from 0.5 down to 1e-55, with signal_trials_run 0. w221 reports identical_script_failures 20 and trials_used 0. w213 reports that the same /work/t1.py was resubmitted many times with the same pandas rolling MemoryError. w212 reports that after roughly the 20th run_code call every subsequent call returned byte-identical stdout regardless of script content, and that the budget was consumed by those calls. w219 reports roughly 60 re-sends of one engine with only the filename changed. w101 reports that from call ~49 onward every call returned byte-identical output. w110 reports the harness silently re-ran the same script about 60 times. At the swarm level this is visible as tool_budget_blocked 21 in wave 1 and 18 in wave 2, and as provider_denied 'Task budget envelope exhausted' 17 times in wave 1. CHANGE. (1) The harness hashes each run_code script and its stdout; if a new call's stdout hash equals the previous call's, the call is refused and not charged, with an explicit message naming the repeated-output condition. (2) The budget counter shown to the worker counts distinct-result calls, with a separate hard cap on total calls. (3) The worker prompt states the rule: if a call returns identical output twice, change the algorithm, do not resend. EXPECTED EFFECT. The digest's own accounting attributes 20-85 calls per affected worker to this mode; refusing and not charging those calls returns that budget to trials. It also removes the silent case where a harness fault is mistaken for a market result. HOW TO TEST. Instrument the next wave for (a) number of refused identical-output calls per agent, (b) tool_budget_blocked count, (c) provider_denied 'Task budget envelope exhausted' count, (d) trials_used at filing. Success = tool_budget_blocked and envelope-exhausted denials fall below the wave-1 figures (21 and 17) while filed records stay at or above 25.
papers.evidence: Performance block: w1 tool_budget_blocked 21, provider_denied 'Task budget envelope exhausted' 1 plus 'agent terminal: Task budget envelope exhausted' 17, run_code total 1992; w2 tool_budget_blocked 18, run_code total 2254. Digest: w215 wasted_calls 55 with signal_trials_run 0; w221 identical_script_failures 20 with trials_used 0; w213 same-script resubmission; w212 byte-identical stdout after ~20 calls; w219 ~60 re-sends; w101 byte-identical output from call ~49; w110 same script re-run ~60 times.
papers.title: Swarm improvement: a run_code call that returns identical output twice must be refused, and the budget must count distinct results rather than calls

papers.decision: Adopt the per-signal-type placebo declaration, the placebo_std > 0 lint assertion, and mandatory reporting of placebo mean/std/p95/max plus the per-year placebo max. This tightens reporting of the existing rule; it does not change the 200-shuffle count or any effect-size floor.
papers.description: EVIDENCE FROM THIS RUN. The protocol fixes the placebo as 200 shuffled days, and the digest shows that this null is frequently degenerate. w224 reports that three distinct implementations each produced an invariant null, with broken_placebo_max 10.858 equal to observed_gross_bps 10.858 and broken_placebo_std 0, for a fixed-time-of-day signal, and that the fix is to permute the return, the funding vector and the timestamp jointly. w209 reports that the day-shuffle is invariant for a within-day cross-section and proposes a sign-flip or within-symbol circular shift instead. w202 reports that the within-symbol permutation is the wrong null for a cross-sectional signal and proposes a joint cross-symbol day permutation. w108 reports that for a cross-sectional signal the day-permutation placebo is centred well above zero (placebo_mean 11.22, placebo_max 13.62, placebo_std 0.96 against real 14.15), so the max rather than zero is the binding bar. w203 reports that the pooled placebo max is too weak a bar and that the per-year placebo max rejects a cell the pooled test passes (pooled placebo_max -8.54 versus per-year maxima 64.8, 37.1, 55.1, 61.3, 250.2). r302 reports a method discrepancy between worker and referee placebo construction (worker placebo mean 11.22 versus referee placebo mean -8.5) on the same candidate. CHANGE. (1) The protocol requires the placebo to be declared per signal type: within-symbol day shuffle for time-series signals, joint cross-symbol day permutation for cross-sectional signals, joint permutation of return, funding and timestamp for fixed-time-of-day signals. (2) The pre-submit lint asserts placebo_std > 0 and that placebo_max differs from the observed statistic. (3) Every candidate reports placebo mean, std, p95 and max, and the per-year placebo max alongside the pooled one. EXPECTED EFFECT. Two of the digest's two referee-reviewed candidates were judged on placebo evidence that the referee had to reconstruct; a declared, non-degenerate null removes that ambiguity and prevents a dead signal from appearing to beat a placebo that cannot move. HOW TO TEST. In the next wave, count (a) records whose placebo_std is 0 or whose placebo_max equals the observed value, (b) records where worker and referee placebo means differ by more than the placebo std, (c) candidates that pass the pooled but fail the per-year placebo max. Success = (a) and (b) are zero.
papers.evidence: Digest: w224 broken_placebo_max 10.858 equals observed_gross_bps 10.858 with broken_placebo_std 0 and n_bugs_found 3; w209 day-shuffle invariant for within-day cross-sections; w202 within-symbol permutation wrong null for cross-sectional signals; w108 placebo_mean 11.22, placebo_max 13.62, placebo_std 0.96, real 14.15; w203 pooled placebo_max -8.54 versus per-year maxima 64.8/37.1/55.1/61.3/250.2; r302 worker placebo mean 11.22 versus referee placebo mean -8.5. Constants: placebo_shuffles 200.
papers.title: Swarm improvement: the 200-shuffled-day placebo is a no-op for fixed-time-of-day and cross-sectional signals; require a placebo_std > 0 assertion and a null that can move the statistic

papers.decision: Adopt the protected confirmation look, the verbatim spec_code handoff to referees, and the 'unconfirmed, look not taken' filing status. The confirmation window (confirm_from 2026-05-01, last_data_day 2026-10-22) and the one-look rule are unchanged; only the scheduling and reporting of that look change.
papers.description: EVIDENCE FROM THIS RUN. The digest holds 161 records and trials_total 2106. Exactly two records are referee reports: r301 on w204-f24-cand-mom7-h24-k5 and r302 on w108-f08-cand-flow24-lowvol-h4. Both carry verdict 'not confirmed'. r301's candidate reproduced exactly (rederive_gross_bps 145.5, rederive_net19_bps 126.5, rederive_matches_claim true) and survived look-ahead, cost, funding, purge/embargo and parameter-neighbourhood attacks, but its own kill criterion fired on the one look: look_net_bps 221.8 against look_placebo_max 536.1, look_real_percentile_in_placebo 0.25, and per_year_beats_placebo_max false in 2022, 2024 and 2026. r302's candidate also reproduced exactly (rederive_net_bps 14.15, rederive_n_trades 175194, rederive_matches_claim true) and beat a fresh 200-shuffle placebo (placebo_fresh_max -5.13, placebo_fresh_z 27.44), yet look_taken is false and look_n_trades is 0 because the referee's budget was exhausted (referee_trials_used 30 of 30). So of two candidates that reached a referee, one was refuted by the confirmation slice and one was never confirmed at all. CHANGE. (1) The protocol reserves the confirmation-slice look as a named, protected step: a candidate filing must be accompanied by a reserved call allocation for the single look, and the look is executed before any further discovery trials by that agent. (2) The referee task receives the candidate's spec_code verbatim and a fixed attack list, so the referee does not spend its budget reconstructing the worker's placebo. (3) A candidate whose look was not taken is filed as 'unconfirmed, look not taken' and is not counted as a positive in any wave summary. EXPECTED EFFECT. The digest's own numbers show the cost of the current arrangement: 2106 trials produced 2 referee-reviewed candidates, 0 confirmed. Protecting the look converts the second of those two into a real verdict in either direction, which is the only outcome that advances the tournament. HOW TO TEST. In the next wave, record for every candidate (a) whether the confirmation look was taken, (b) the look's net bps and placebo max, (c) referee trials used. Success = every filed candidate has look_taken true, and the count of confirmed candidates is reported honestly rather than left at 0 by omission.

papers.title: Swarm improvement: 161 records produced 2 referee-reviewed candidates and both came back not confirmed, one because the single confirmation look was never taken; reserve the confirmation slice before the discovery sweep

papers.decision: Carry the prompt_patch below into the next wave's worker prompt as advice only. It cannot and does not change the evaluation rules: trial counting, walk-forward by year, the 14-19 bps round trip plus funding, the 200-shuffled-day placebo maximum, the 0.12 and 0.35 effect-size floors, the one look per candidate on the confirmation slice, the 2026-10-23 data cutoff and the lockbox exclusion all stand unchanged.
papers.description: EVIDENCE FROM THIS RUN. (1) Filing latency: wave 1 reached time_to_first_finding_min 0.1 but time_to_median_finding_min 16.7 over wall_minutes 395.5, and wave 2 reached 0.1 and 20.8 over wall_minutes 360.1, while the no-code control steps c1-c3 filed 2 records each in wall_minutes 1.7, 1.3 and 1.1 at spent_per_filed_usd 0.057, 0.078 and 0.066. The gap is not analysis quality, it is that workers hold their filing until the end. (2) Gross-first gating: the digest's negatives repeatedly show that the binding constraint is the gross edge versus the 14-19 bps round trip, not the cost model. w101 reports max_gross_bps_per_trade 4.22 against a 14 bps floor; w105 reports gross_bps_per_trade_test_years 3.09; w106 reports gross_bps_per_trade_range 0 to 1.71; w218 reports best_gross_bps 2.32; w205 reports gross_bps_per_trade_best 2.6; w224 reports gross_bps_per_trade 10.858 against 14 bps and kills the slot before the placebo. (3) Identical resends: w215 wasted_calls 55, w221 identical_script_failures 20, w212 byte-identical stdout after ~20 calls. CHANGE. A prompt patch of advice only, carried on this record, telling the next wave's workers to file a lint-clean partial record as soon as real numbers exist, to compute gross and net-14 and net-19 side by side and kill on gross before spending trials on cost modelling, and to change the algorithm rather than resend when a call returns identical output. EXPECTED EFFECT. Earlier filing bounds the loss when a budget guard or harness fault truncates a run, and gross-first gating stops trials being spent on cost engineering for signals that cannot pay the floor. HOW TO TEST. Compare the next wave against wave 1 and wave 2 on time_to_median_finding_min (16.7 and 20.8), on the number of records filed with trials_used 0, and on calls_per_filed (83.9 and 97.4).
papers.evidence: Performance block: w1 time_to_first_finding_min 0.1, time_to_median_finding_min 16.7, wall_minutes 395.5, calls_per_filed 83.9; w2 time_to_first_finding_min 0.1, time_to_median_finding_min 20.8, wall_minutes 360.1, calls_per_filed 97.4; c1 wall_minutes 1.7 spent_per_filed_usd 0.057; c2 wall_minutes 1.3 spent_per_filed_usd 0.078; c3 wall_minutes 1.1 spent_per_filed_usd 0.066. Digest: w101 max_gross_bps_per_trade 4.22; w105 gross_bps_per_trade_test_years 3.09; w106 gross_bps_per_trade_range 0 to 1.71; w218 best_gross_bps 2.32; w205 gross_bps_per_trade_best 2.6; w224 gross_bps_per_trade 10.858; w215 wasted_calls 55; w221 identical_script_failures 20; w212 identical stdout after ~20 calls. Constants: cost_rt_bps_low 14, cost_rt_bps_high 19.
papers.prompt_patch: File a lint-clean partial record as soon as you have real numbers; do not hold it to the end. Print gross, net-14 and net-19 side by side and kill on gross before spending trials on cost modelling: if gross bps/trade is under 14, stop. If a run_code call returns identical output twice, change the algorithm, never resend. Never zero-fill missing funding; mask it. State trials_used honestly, including 0.
papers.title: Swarm improvement: prompt patch for the next wave's workers - file early, gate on gross before cost, and never resend an identical script
